svg.title: Delta: distributaries, flocculation and delta beds
svg.desc: A plan view of a river carrying a large load into a calm sea, where it slows and deposits so that the delta builds out beyond the old coastline and the river splits into distributaries; a cross-section shows topset, foreset and bottomset beds, and a close-up shows flocculation, where salt water makes fine clay clump together and sink.

text.tspan: e.g. Nile Delta, Egypt; lake delta at Glendalough
